newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech August real farm revenue falls 7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech August real farm revenue falls 7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Total revenues, in inflation-adjusted terms, from Czech farming enterprises fell seven percent year-on-year in August, putting revenues for January-August down 3.3 percent, the Czech Statistical Office said on Tuesday.

The figures refer to the sale of own goods and services in total. Revenues from agricultural production alone were down 8.5 percent year-on-year in August and 4.5 percent in the January to August period.

The statistical office added that the number of workers employed in the agricultural sector rose in absolute terms to 148,521 from 146,976 in the previous month but was some 5.5 percent lower than in August 1995. The average monthly farm wage was 8,579 crowns, up from 8,231 in July the office added.
